text:
Sara Lopez: Quick thread to lock down scope for the next DP cohort (Private + Dedicated hybrid). Goal: validate onboarding friction, perf at scale, and long-term commit signals. Proposal: 8 partners, staggered start over 3 weeks, pilot windows 21	60 days depending on integration.

Tom Becker: 8 seems right. Suggest 3 regulated customers (health/fin), 2 mid-market SaaS, 2 platform infra teams, 1 strategic reseller partner.

Nina Zhao: Let's make sure one partner is focused on embeddings for search relevance (different SLA). We need embedding throughput and 99th percentile latency targets.

Sara Lopez: Good call. We'll set separate SLOs: gen SLOs and embed SLOs. Gen baseline: p50 < 70ms, p95 < 250ms @ 256 tokens. Embed baseline: p50 < 20ms, p95 < 60ms @ 768-dim.

Marco Diaz: Recruitment questions: Q1) Compliance regime (HIPAA, SOC2, PCI) Q2) Expected steady QPS and burst QPS Q3) Critical uptime windows Q4) Do you have an internal eval set we can use?

legal-bot: Add: consent to anonymized metrics + permission to run controlled synthetic load tests. Also include safe harbor clause for pilot limitations.

Tom Becker: Incentives: 2 months of free Dedicated credits + 10 hours of white-glove eng support + option for early access to new model variants. Add co-marketing for strategic partners.

Nina Zhao: Success criteria (per partner): 1) Integration time <= 10 days OR documented blockers logged 2) Perf SLOs met in production-like run 3) Feedback loop: >= 6 labeled failure cases + prioritized fixes 4) Adoption indicator: >=5% production traffic routed to Redwood Dedicated or plan to commit within 90 days.

Sara Lopez: Also track per-partner engineering effort (FTE-days) and time-to-reproduce regressions. We should capture "time from partner report to triage ticket" and "triage to fix" as ops metrics.

Marco Diaz: Measurement tools we'll provide: lightweight agent for token-level tracing, replay harness (private repo), and a Prometheus scrape endpoint for partner infra to pull metrics. We'll version the agent so partners can pin.

ops-bot: NOTE: Maintenance windows allowed Tue/Wed 02:00-04:00 PT during pilot. Limited SLA: 99.8% for reserved windows. Ops will cap concurrent partners on shared infra during stress tests.

Tom Becker: Outreach copy should emphasize: shortened onboarding paths, security posture (KMS/HSM), data residency zones, and what we need from the partner. Keep it <200 words.

Nina Zhao: For feedback, require partners to supply 6 prompt families (10 examples each) or 200 embedding queries, whichever applies. Each issue must include a reproduction case and severity tag.

Sara Lopez: For epics/prioritization: we'll accept scope trades: more eng time -> shorter pilot or vice versa. Capture trades in a single tracker sheet with approvals.

Marco Diaz: Screener draft (2 quicks): 1) Primary use-case + compliance needs 2) Monthly query volume + peak concurrency 3) Preferred start window 4) Willingness to share eval sets? Keep it one page.

legal-bot: DP agreement checklist shared in #legal-dp. Need sign-off before outreach. NDA template OK with minor edits.

Tom Becker: Any objections to requiring partners to run our agent in a staging environment for 7 days before production rollout? That helps reproducibility.

Nina Zhao: No objections. Add a validation step: partner-run smoke tests must pass before production flip. We'll provide smoke test scripts.

Sara Lopez: Post-pilot asks: 1) 30-day follow-up to collect retention/adoption signals, 2) optional case study within 90 days, 3) roadmap feedback session to collect product commitments.

Marco Diaz: Logistics: recruiting opens Monday, closes in 10 business days. Kickoffs staggered: week-of 2025-11-17 start window.

Tom Becker: Action items: @Marco - finalize screener and outreach draft by Friday EOD. @Nina - prepare embed perf checklist and smoke tests by next Wed. @Sara - create DP tracker sheet and trade log. @Legal - review DP agreement and flag risky clauses.

Marco Diaz: Will post outreach draft to #product/outreach by 17:00 PT Friday.

dp-bot: COHORT CREATED dp-hybrid-2025-11. Invitations queued for 8 prospects. Calendar invites will be issued after legal sign-off.

Sara Lopez: One more: include a one-sentence "pilot exit criteria" in outreach so partners know what success looks like. I'll draft and share tomorrow.

Tom Becker: Thanks everyone. If you want to join the invite review huddle Monday 08:30 PT, ping me.

ops-bot: Reminder: Ops readiness doc https://redwood-internal.example/ops/dp-readiness (private).
